name: integer-precision-native-only
description: Validates that SDKs with 64-bit integer flag evaluation preserve values outside JavaScript's safe integer range (Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER = 2^53-1).

_skip.reason: JavaScript cannot represent integers beyond 2^53-1 without loss of precision. This fixture uses a value outside the safe JavaScript integer range.
The Android public integer flag evaluation API currently uses Int32 and cannot represent this value. Revisit when the API supports Long.
